summary: Larimer County parks ranger reported missing ~9:18 p.m. during a strong wind event on Horsetooth Reservoir; his boat was found on the water with him gone; body recovered ~3:30 a.m. Aug 21 after an overnight multi-agency search
responding_agency: Larimer County Sheriff's Office; Larimer County Search and Rescue; Larimer County Dive Rescue Team; Poudre Fire Authority; Colorado State Patrol; Colorado Parks and Wildlife; Denver Police Department helicopter; Larimer County Dept. of Natural Resources
notes: Search launched Aug 20 night; body recovered from the water ~3:30 a.m. Fri Aug 21; coroner investigating cause, identity/manner release pending at publication.
